# binjgb

Vendored from [binji/binjgb](https://github.com/binji/binjgb/tree/c60e138da5a795ebb55e56b11b7e90024e41112c).

The browser files in `web/` come from the upstream `docs/` directory:

- `binjgb.js`
- `binjgb.wasm`
- `pallet-web.js` (renamed from upstream `simple.js` and given a ROM placeholder)
- `pallet-web.css` (renamed from upstream `simple.css`)

The upstream files are MIT licensed. The renamed files retain the upstream contents except for the ROM placeholder in `pallet-web.js`. See the upstream [LICENSE](https://github.com/binji/binjgb/blob/c60e138da5a795ebb55e56b11b7e90024e41112c/LICENSE).
